svg.aria-label: Replacing a failed trainer in fault-tolerant training with torchft: on every step the replica groups average their gradients with an all-reduce. When one trainer pod is lost the others pause briefly and keep stepping as three, SkyPilot creates only the missing pod, and the replacement copies the model and optimizer state from a live trainer before it joins the next step.
svg.text: Replacing a failed trainer without restarting the job
Trainers, one torchft replica group each

g.text: Every step, gradients are averaged across all replica groups
Model and optimizer state, copied from a live trainer
On every step, all four replica groups average
Trainer 2 is lost. The all-reduce pauses for a few seconds,
until the lighthouse drops it from the quorum.
SkyPilot creates only the missing pod.
The replacement copies the model and optimizer state
from a live trainer. No checkpoint is loaded.
The job stayed running the whole time.
